messages.text: Heads up, Q3 access recert for AuthSSO groups is due Friday. I'm pulling the entitlement export for the Technology-owned apps now. Anyone know who's covering ReconLegacy service accounts?
That's mine historically. ReconLegacy has two Oracle service accounts plus the batch OS user. I'll attest to those, but honestly half the humans with DB access there haven't touched it in a year.
Reminder the recert tool only shows AuthSSO group membership, not the local Oracle grants. For ReconLegacy we need to dump dba_role_privs separately or we're attesting blind.
Good point. Can you run that dump, Vincent? I'll attach it to the recert ticket so reviewers can compare against the SSO export.
Yep, will do it after lunch. Read-only query on the replica so no impact on the EOD batch.
Also worth flagging: I leave Oct 9, so anything I own needs a new attestor before then. I'd rather not have my name on the Q4 cycle for ReconLegacy at all.
Right, noted. I'll propose Vincent or myself as the new owner contact for the service accounts. Let's settle it before the handoff doc goes out.
I can take ReconLegacy. I'm already the one who gets paged when the Perl job hangs anyway.
Found three stale entries in the AuthSSO admin group: two contractors whose engagements ended in the spring and one person who moved teams. Should I revoke now or wait for the recert sign-off?
Revoke now, no reason to wait. Just note it on the ticket with the timestamp so the audit trail shows we caught it before the cycle closed.
Done. Removed all three and logged them in the ticket.
Dump is attached. Heads up, one shared DBA account still has a password that predates the rotation policy. Needs to go on the exceptions list or get rotated.
Ugh. Rotating is risky because the batch scripts hardcode it. Let's list it as an exception with a remediation date and I'll open a ticket to move it to the vault.
Agree. I can help with the Perl side, it's just two config files plus the wrapper script. Should take an afternoon, then we can test in the Oracle 11g staging box.
Perfect. I'll schedule the staging test for next week so it lands before Priya's last day.
Great, I'll submit the Technology recert package to Compliance Thursday afternoon with the exceptions noted. Thanks both.
